text: Wuhan Control. Japan Air 782. We have a fast-moving traffic in front of us. It looks like a fighter from here. We do not have it on our TCAS. Have you observed it? Japan Airlines 782. We didn't see it on our radar either. Probably a fighter without a transponder, or not using a transponder. Question. What are they talking about?
